title: Whose Name Is On The Gas
subject: sorting out a utility bill after someone moves out
caption: Three-step, the spacious swung successor to 2-step. Shuffled kick with a wide swing, dubby minor chord stabs left to decay into silence, deep round sub, one closed hat and nothing else, deliberate negative space where a fill would be. Half-spoken male lead recorded close and left unprocessed, one whispered double on the hook. 132 BPM, C minor. Numb, practical, quietly funny. No 2-step garage skippers, no vocal chops, no build, no drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - shuffled kick and one chord stab]

[Chorus]
Whose name is on the gas
Whose name is on the gas
You took the router and you left the bill
Whose name is on the gas

[Verse 1]
Taped a key to a note that said sorry about the couch
Couch is fine, the couch was always fine
Landlord wants one signature, doesn't care which
I've been reading the same paragraph since Thursday

[Chorus]
Whose name is on the gas
Whose name is on the gas
You took the router and you left the bill
Whose name is still on the gas

[Instrumental Break - stabs and silence]

[Verse 2]
Your mother texts me happy birthday two days early, every year
I don't correct her
Half the mugs, all the forks
Somebody has to call about the forks

[Outro - filter closing]
Whose name is on the gas
